messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area consists of the four corners of the square, the midpoints of all four sides, the center point, and four additional points placed symmetrically along the lines x=1/2 and y=1/2 at coordinates (1/2, 1/6), (1/2, 5/6), (1/6, 1/2), and (5/6, 1/2). This arrangement produces a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/48, achieved by multiple triples of points, and no configuration of 13 points in the unit square can yield a larger minimum area."}
